summary.text: Joseph Espinola III is an unenrolled candidate for the Massachusetts State Senate, 1st Middlesex District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Espinola was the Republican nominee for the 2nd Essex and Middlesex District Senate seat in 2018, when he lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Barry Finegold.
He also ran as an unenrolled candidate in the March 3, 2026 special general election for the 1st Middlesex District, which Democrat Vanna Howard won over Republican Sam Meas and Espinola.
